name: jira
description: Jira Cloud issues: search with JQL, read, create, comment, and transition

Jira.description: Jira Cloud (declare it with your site: Jira(site: "acme") for acme.atlassian.net)

methods.name: search
methods.description: Search issues with JQL, e.g. project = ENG AND status = "In Progress".

methods.name: get_issue
methods.description: Get an issue by key, e.g. ENG-123.

methods.name: create_issue
methods.description: Create an issue. fields needs project ({"key": ...}), summary, and issuetype ({"name": "Task"}).

methods.name: add_comment
methods.description: Comment on an issue. body is Atlassian Document Format: {"type":"doc","version":1,"content":[{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"..."}]}]}.

methods.name: list_transitions
methods.description: List the transitions (status changes) an issue can make now.

methods.name: transition
methods.description: Move an issue to another status: transition is {"id": ...} from list_transitions.
